title: August and the Orchard
author: Paloma Ashgrove
blurb: Ines Sandoval, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
